scope: Rules-based V2 critic for arcane pull orb reads.

detection_rules: HeroArcaneSweep emitter is missing or under-authored.
Hero arcane sweep is not visually distinct from support layers.
hero_sweep_missing.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hero-layer failures force a rebuild.

detection_rules: HeroArcaneSweep does not read as magical energy being drawn toward the core.
no_outside_to_core_read.escalation_rule: Two consecutive failures force a rebuild.

detection_rules: Hero arcane layer reads as sharp electrical zigzags instead of smooth magical pull.
electrical_zigzag_dominance.escalation_rule: Repeated hits force a hero rebuild.

detection_rules: Layer overlap closes into a ring shell around the orb.
closed_ring_orb.escalation_rule: If repeated on the hero layer, rebuild the hero sweep.

secondary_overwhelms_hero.escalation_rule: Reduce secondary support before touching the hero sweep.

detection_rules: Arcane streak material is too graphic or line-heavy instead of flowing magical mass.
linework_not_flame_body.escalation_rule: Simplify the body before increasing glow.

detection_rules: Core glow overwhelms internal arcane detail and collapses the orb into haze.
over_bloomed_glyph_haze.escalation_rule: Reduce bloom dominance while keeping readable core detail.
